mapper.select:
SELECT v.*, d.name as doctor_name, dept.name as dept_name FROM visit v LEFT JOIN doctor d ON v.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON v.dept_id = dept.id WHERE v.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND dept.deleted = 0
AND v.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND v.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
ORDER BY v.visit_time DESC
